environment.description: Same Quarkus Lambda handler deployed behind API Gateway (REST API type) with the following infrastructure controls: (1) AWS Secrets Manager rotation Lambda configured with RotationSchedule of 60-second AutomaticallyAfterDays equivalent via custom cron(* * * * * *) expression using AWSCURRENT/AWSPENDING staging labels — the oauth.client.secret ConfigProperty is resolved via quarkus-amazon-secretsmanager extension with cache TTL of 0 (always fetches current version); (2) Authorization code TTL in DynamoDB is 10 seconds with conditional delete on exchange; (3) CloudFront distribution in front of API Gateway with Lambda@Edge viewer-request function that performs RFC 3986 normalization, removes dot-segments, rejects URIs containing '@' character in path component, and validates redirect_uri query parameter against exact-match allowlist before forwarding to origin. The Lambda@Edge function source hash is pinned in CloudFormation with drift detection enabled.
